Type: live-edge wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: rustic, industrial, modern
Materials: solid acacia wood slab with a grey wash, raw iron legs
Colors: dark grey-brown wood, black iron
Shape: long low slab top with natural wavy live edges, two U-shaped sled legs set inward, low and wide, substantial
Feel: organic, grounded, moody
Goes with: charcoal or leather sofas, stone or concrete, black accents; rustic modern or industrial living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Garrett Rustic Acacia-Wood Coffee Table with Iron Legs, 52"W, Gray and Raw Metal
product.description: Constructed of acacia, this coffee table touts a beautiful rustic style with visual knots and cracks covered with a sheer gray finish. Each unique piece has a live-edge top that sits on an open metalwork base. This table complements rustic, farmhouse, and contemporary decor with ease. 52"W x 26"D x 14"H Acacia and iron This rustic coffee table offers a natural beauty with a live-edge top that features knots and cracks, making each piece unique. A natural clear finish allows the beauty of the wood to shine through while protecting the surface. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
